sources.title: Inside the Chip: Powering the Future of Advanced Packaging

watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「散熱蓋與熱介面材料」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Heat spreaders and thermal-interface materials. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「建立熱源地圖」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Build a heat-source map requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「校正溫度量測」列為查證任務：觀察焦點：以獨立溫度感測點驗證一個 IR 區域。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Calibrate temperature measurement: Observation focus: Validate one IR region with an independent temperature sensor. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.overview: 相似工法的重點是可轉移的物理與證據；下列比較保留各自不同的材料和模型邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Related methods share transferable physics and evidence while retaining distinct materials and model boundaries.

related.title: 微流道晶片冷卻
related.why: 熱阻網路可定位液冷前的界面瓶頸
related.whyEn: Thermal networks locate interface bottlenecks upstream of liquid cooling
related.transfer: 熱阻網路可定位液冷前的界面瓶頸
related.transferEn: Thermal networks locate interface bottlenecks upstream of liquid cooling
related.difference: TIM 是固體接觸問題，微流道還需壓降與泵功
related.differenceEn: TIM is a solid-contact problem; microchannels add pressure drop and pump power
practice: 畫出「散熱蓋與熱介面材料」與「微流道晶片冷卻」的材料、能量或資料交接。
以「建立熱源地圖」為比較起點，指出兩課共享的守恆或量測原理。
提出一個會使「熱阻網路可定位液冷前的界面瓶頸」失效的邊界條件，並安排驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the material, energy or data handoff between Heat spreaders and thermal-interface materials and Microchannel chip cooling.
Use build a heat-source map to identify a shared conservation or measurement principle.
State and test one boundary that would invalidate this transfer: Thermal networks locate interface bottlenecks upstream of liquid cooling

courses.summary: 本課以熱擴散、接觸熱阻與 TIM 厚度連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through heat spreading, contact resistance and tim thickness. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.
